reuse.why: Routes every planning path (template, forecast, action sync, posting, preview, API, balance) through the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Removes five inline midpoint copies in favour of the one shared helper and adds no new copies.

placement.why: The expected-amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts and the tolerance comes from shared/rules.ts, where the tree keeps that logic.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the API type addition and Balance.tsx update are in scope, though some display callers are left without the operator.

maintainability.why: A single definition is easy to own; the loosely typed op string inserted positionally before inverse, and client callers (SchedulesTable, mobile list) that still omit op, make the approximate rule easy to miss.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an op parameter and an isapprox branch for a real variation of the rule; all touched call sites use the helper, none re-implement it.
